modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: set-up and adjust the machine tools, fixtures/jigs and cutting tools as per the process requirement
lift the work piece/metal stock manually or by hoist, position the same securely on the machine bed using fasteners and hand tools and verify their positions with measuring instruments if required
check the working of different holding fixtures, gears, stops etc. to prevent work piece movement using hand tools, power tools, tightening tools, torque measuring instruments etc.
follow the do's and don’ts of the manufacturing process as defined in SOPs/Work Instructions or given by supervisors
set the machine for auto cycle
check and confirm the level of lubricant and flow-rate in the storage tank as per control plan
start the turning/drilling/reaming/tapping/boring for operations
ensure that the right programme is selected in the CNC machine as defined in the SOP
maintain length to bore ratio of the tool to avoid deflection of cutting tool in case of boring operations
turn on the coolant valves and start its flow to maintain temperature of work piece and tool
brush or spray lubricating material on work pieces as per requirement
take appropriate action in case of any irregularities e.g. power failure, rejection, tool breakage etc.
extract or lift jammed pieces from machines through use of wire hooks, lift bars, hands etc.

record the data related to the loss time in case of machine stops
maintain the record of tool offsetting and key dimensions on control charts/SPC record as per organization policies

ensure that all the tools are put in the right pockets
ensure tool replacement as per recommended tool life in number of pieces

modules.module_title: Perform de- burring activity on the machined components

pcs.pc_description: conduct de-burring operations with the help of correct tool to remove extra burrs, sharp edges, rust and chips from the metal surface
use Personal Protective equipment (PPE) like goggles and hand gloves
use automated technique to conduct shot blasting/vibro processes for completing de-burring operations
clean machine parts as per the defined process and quality control standards
check the component as per the control plan, work instructions for product quality

separate the defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces which are beyond repair and maintain records of each category
get the inspection done by QA in the Standard Room for critical components and record the observations
maintain the machine as per proper operational condition/daily maintenance check list
